description: Weimer models estimate high-latitude ionospheric electric potential from empirical satellite relationships. CCMC documents an IDL implementation and a real-time configuration driven by solar-wind observations. The resource is documented by Virginia Tech. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Instant Run, Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Statistical input-output relations cannot resolve every local electrodynamic feature. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
